items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I played with Buddy Petit. At the time I played with Buddy Petit, he had an eight-piece band.

ctx.x: He was a good little trumpet player. He played something on the order of Buddy Petit.

items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: They played pretty much the same with Buddy Petit as with Kid Thomas.

ctx.x: Yeah. See, them bands in them days, Trump, they was a leader and whatever he played, just

baller. Did you ever change your style much when you played with different bands? another trumpet player that would play one way with one band. another trumpet player that played a different way? They played pretty much the same with Buddy Petit as with Kid Thomas. Yeah. They played pretty much the same with Buddy Petit as with Kid Thomas. Yeah. Yeah.
